siteFilter.description: Optional domain allow-list. When set, results from other domains are filtered out (host MAY translate to an engine-specific `site:` operator).

suitability.description: ADR 0101 P4 licensing gate: `durable` means results will be STORED as evidence, so a provider licensed only for answer-display must not back the call. Read from config OR inputs (ADR 0502). Declared per ADR 0525 (GRD-8).

maxResults.description: Result cap (clamped to 50). Read from config OR inputs — the node was config-only until ADR 0525, so two chains asking for 8 here silently ran at the default 5.
